annotation_origin.citation: Bittner, Pasalo, Bosch, Meseguer Brocal and Rubinstein (2021), vocadito, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5578807
annotation_origin.convention: Published Tony note edition A1; source-second onset and duration; pitch supplied in Hz; publisher musician piano-style segmentation; A1 and A2 retained separately, no best-reference selection

coverage.mask_rule: Exclude any event overlapping an uncertain source interval; report exclusions and unmasked scores too

errors.definitions: Missed/unmatched use onset+pitch matching; fragmentation/merger are overlap diagnostics, not human error labels

downstream.pitch_binning: Nearest MIDI semitone for compositional summaries only; accuracy scoring retains continuous note centers
downstream.interpretation: Sensitivity to transcription, not proof of artist style; same rest rule applied to both editions

frames.reference_kind: published or manually corrected continuous F0; not derived from notes

repeated_pitch_subset.definition: Adjacent reference pitches within 50 cents and gaps <=500ms; no new human attack labels inferred

short_note_subset.definition: Reference durations <=180ms; NOT equivalent to human-labeled melismas

provenance.timestamp_convention: centered F0 frames at sample index k*hop; event spans [start,end)

performance.scope: Wall includes worker startup/imports/cache access/exports and external model children; RSS is summed concurrent process-tree resident memory, not exclusive RAM or GPU memory

runtime.scope: Segmentation/features/exports only; parent F0 inference excluded
